question.prompt: What is the area of the triangle enclosed by the line \(y=2x-8\) and the two coordinate axes?

solutions.explanation: The intersections with the x-axis and y-axis are \((4,0)\) and \((0,-8)\), respectively. The two legs have lengths 4 and 8, so the area \(=4\times8\div2=16\).
solutions.title: Use the intercepts as triangle legs
